_readme: Central list of partner links used on /travel/ pages. Each link on a page has data-affiliate="<key>" and a plain href to the real page. When a program approves you, paste your tracked link into tracked_url and set status to "active"; /travel/affiliates.js swaps it in on page load. Leave tracked_url empty until then. No IDs here are real yet.

discovercars-edinburgh.program: Discover Cars affiliate (direct or via Travelpayouts)

booking-edinburgh.note: Booking.com's Awin program ended June 30 2026; join via CJ or Travelpayouts instead
